# Parameter icons

Every engine parameter has a label, a hover text and an icon (`awva::ParamDesc`, `nsc_param`: `label`, `hover`, `icon`; the source is `param_text/<engine>.json`). The icon is a concept, `<concept>`, or a concept with a modifier, `<concept>+<modifier>`; the drawings are `assets/icons/<concept>.svg` and `assets/icons/mod-<modifier>.svg`, the names are stable.

Every icon is 24 x 24, 1.5 px strokes with round caps and joins in `currentColor`; the only fills are the pedal's dot and the knockout. To draw `<concept>+<modifier>`: the concept, then a disc of the background's colour at (19, 19), radius 5.5, then the modifier's mark. At 14 to 16 px a modifier is a hint: the label and the hover text carry the meaning.

A build with `AWVA_PARAM_TEXT 0` (an embedded host that shows no text) has none of the strings: the three are NULL. The text is not part of a preset or of `schema_hash`: rewording it changes no stored value.

A new parameter picks its concept (and modifier) from these; a new concept is a new icon here and a row in `assets/icons/icons.json`.
